# Awais Ahmad Portfolio

> Portfolio website for Awais Ahmad, a software engineer and full-stack mobile app developer focused on Flutter, React, TypeScript, and product-focused app development.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://awaisahmd.me/): Portfolio homepage with profile, skills, experience, projects, guestbook, and contact sections.
- [Projects](https://awaisahmd.me/projects): Main project gallery featuring Shukar Daily, Lumina, and PackSavvy.
- [Blog](https://awaisahmd.me/blog): Technical writing and development articles.
- [Contact](https://awaisahmd.me/contact): Contact page for project inquiries.

## Featured Apps

- [Shukar Daily](https://awaisahmd.me/apps/shukar-daily): Offline-first Islamic gratitude journal and counter app.
- [Lumina](https://awaisahmd.me/apps/lumina): Cosmetic ingredient scanner and skin safety analyzer.
- [PackSavvy](https://awaisahmd.me/apps/packsavvy): Travel packing list and trip planning app.

## Featured Blog Posts

- [Flutter State Management in 2026](https://awaisahmd.me/blog/flutter-state-management-2026): Comparison of setState, Provider, Riverpod, and BLoC for Flutter applications.

## Site Files

- [Sitemap](https://awaisahmd.me/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap for public pages.
- [Robots](https://awaisahmd.me/robots.txt): Crawling rules and sitemap location.
